hero.title: From a family profile to a conversation that feels right.
hero.body: Matrimonial introductions deserve more care than endless swiping. Our process keeps the journey clear, private and respectful—from creating a profile to the moment families choose to speak.
hero.note: Nothing moves forward without member choice. Interest, contact and family involvement happen gradually.

process.title: Technology guides the process. People decide the pace.
process.body: Each stage has a clear purpose. You always know what happens next, what the platform does and what remains private.

begin.title: Tell your story with context.
begin.body: Create a profile that reflects more than basic information—education, profession, family background, values and partner preferences.
begin.userDoes: You create the account, verify your mobile and complete the matrimonial profile.
begin.platformDoes: We organise your information into a structured profile and prepare it for review.
begin.private: Your contact information and sensitive details are not openly exposed.

discover.title: Discover people, not endless cards.
discover.body: Once the profile is ready, discovery becomes more focused. Background, preferences and meaningful context help narrow the search.
discover.userDoes: You explore profiles and decide which introductions feel worth considering.
discover.platformDoes: The platform uses preferences and available profile context to support discovery.
discover.private: Browsing does not automatically reveal phone numbers or private details.

interest.title: An introduction begins only when someone chooses it.
interest.body: Instead of immediately sharing contact information, members can express matrimonial interest privately and wait for a response.
interest.userDoes: You express interest, accept, decline or take time before deciding.
interest.platformDoes: We record and communicate interest without forcing a direct contact exchange.
interest.private: A one-sided interest never becomes an automatic match or contact unlock.

connect.title: Mutual interest opens the next conversation.
connect.body: Once interest is mutual, the journey can move from the platform toward direct and family-led conversation.
connect.userDoes: You decide whether to request contact details and involve your family.
connect.platformDoes: We support the transition from mutual interest to the next stage of communication.
connect.private: Contact details stay protected until the relevant stage and permission.

control.title: Privacy is part of the journey, not a premium extra.
control.body: Matrimonial information is personal. The process should give members room to decide what becomes visible and when.

photos.title: Photographs
photos.body: Personal photographs can be handled with visibility controls instead of being treated as public content.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.body: Mobile and WhatsApp information stay protected until the appropriate stage of the journey.

interest.title: Matrimonial interest
interest.body: Interest is private and intentional. A request does not create an obligation to respond or accept.

family.title: Family involvement
family.body: Families can support the process while the person represented by the profile remains central to every decision.

journey.title: There is a process. There is no rush.
journey.body: Every profile moves differently. This is an example of how the journey can progress—not a deadline or promise.

profile.title: Profile created
profile.body: You add personal, professional and family context at your own pace.

review.title: Review & verification
review.body: The profile can be reviewed and prepared for appropriate discovery.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Explore suitable profiles without being pushed toward immediate contact.

mutual.title: Interest aligns
mutual.body: When both sides are comfortable, the introduction can move forward.

family.title: Families decide what comes next
family.body: The platform supports the introduction. The people and families decide the relationship.

cta.title: There is no rush. Start when your family is ready.
cta.body: Create your profile, share what matters to you and move through the process at a pace that feels comfortable.

hero.title: Some beginnings are quiet. Some become a lifetime.
hero.body: No two matrimonial journeys unfold in exactly the same way. These editorial stories show how thoughtful introductions can grow through patience, mutual interest and family conversation.
hero.quote: The best stories do not always begin dramatically. Sometimes they begin with one respectful introduction.

featured.title: A story, one thoughtful step at a time.

chapters.title: Three moments often matter more than the first impression.

first.title: The first introduction feels comfortable.
first.body: A thoughtful profile gives enough context to understand the person without forcing immediate direct contact. Curiosity begins before pressure does.

family.title: Families begin to speak.
family.body: Once interest is mutual, the journey can move from profile discovery to family conversation. Context, expectations and values become clearer.

decision.title: A decision starts taking shape.
decision.body: There is rarely one single moment of certainty. Trust usually develops through time, repeated conversation and the freedom to move at a comfortable pace.

scrapbook.title: A matrimonial journey is more than one match.
scrapbook.body: The real story sits between the milestones: the first profile someone pauses on, a family conversation that lasts longer than expected, or a decision that slowly begins to feel natural.

values.title: A meaningful story should never need pressure.

mutual.title: Mutual interest comes first.
mutual.body: An introduction only becomes meaningful when both sides choose to continue.

family.title: Family involvement has its own pace.
family.body: Families can support the journey without replacing the voice of the person at the centre of the profile.

pace.title: Slow is not the same as uncertain.
pace.body: Taking time to understand someone can be part of a healthy matrimonial process.

cta.title: Your story does not need to look like theirs. It only needs to begin honestly.
cta.body: Create a thoughtful profile, discover people at your own pace and let the next conversation happen when it feels right.

hero.title: Marriage deserves more than an algorithm and a profile card.
hero.body: Kshatriya Matrimonial Society was created around a simple belief: technology should help families discover thoughtfully, without turning one of life's most personal decisions into an endless marketplace.
hero.imageAlt: A family gathered in a heritage setting
hero.imageQuote: A meaningful introduction should feel considered before it ever feels convenient.
hero.trustNote: Profiles, photographs and contact details are designed to move gradually—not automatically.

manifesto.intro: We do not believe better matrimonial technology means making the human decision faster.
manifesto.line3: But people must decide what comes next.

why.title: A calmer way to begin something important.
why.body1: Many matrimonial platforms are built around volume: more profiles, more visibility, more messages and more urgency. We wanted to begin somewhere else—with enough information to make a thoughtful choice, and enough privacy to let trust develop at its own pace.
why.body2: Our role is not to predict a marriage or promise compatibility. Our role is to create a respectful environment where members and families can discover, express interest, mutually accept and reveal contact only when both sides are ready.

principles.title: Four principles shape every product decision.

memberLed.title: Member-led, even when family is involved.
memberLed.body: Parents and families may support the journey, but the person represented by the profile remains at the centre of every introduction.

familyContext.title: Family context without removing individuality.
familyContext.body: Shared cultural context can make introductions more meaningful, but every person, household and expectation remains distinct.

privacy.title: Privacy should be a product behaviour.
privacy.body: Contact information and sensitive profile details should not become public simply because someone created an account.

intent.title: Intent matters more than endless engagement.
intent.body: The platform should help people move toward respectful introductions—not keep them scrolling for the sake of activity.

balance.title: Modern tools. Human pace.
balance.body1: Discovery, preference filtering, moderation, privacy controls and structured contact requests can remove friction from the process.
balance.body2: But software should never replace judgement, family conversations, independent verification or the time people need to understand one another.

tech.title: Technology does
tech.body: Organise information, protect access, narrow discovery and make the journey clearer.

people.title: People decide
people.body: Who feels right, when to speak, how families meet and whether a relationship should move forward.

refuse.title: Growth should not cost the platform its character.
refuse.body: As the society grows, these are boundaries we want the product to remember.

items.swipe: An endless swipe feed designed only to maximise screen time.
items.directory: A public biodata directory where private information is easy to collect.
items.pressure: A system that pressures members to reveal contact details before they are ready.
items.promises: A platform that presents algorithms, badges or cultural similarity as a guarantee of compatibility.

founder.eyebrow: A note from the people building it
founder.quote: We want the product to feel modern without asking our community to leave its dignity, family context or traditions behind.
founder.body: The ambition is not simply to build another matrimonial website. It is to build a platform our own families would feel comfortable using—clear enough for a new generation, respectful enough for the generation that guides them.

cta.title: Create a profile when the journey feels right.
cta.body: Registration begins free. You remain in control of how your profile, interests and contact details move through the platform.
